title: Clock in / clock out is always available, whatever the Timesheets permission
custom_preconds:
1. A user has a role with both Timesheets boxes off.
  2. The user is not on the Time Clock User role.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Find the clock in / out control.
  3. Clock in.
  4. Clock out.
custom_expected:
The clock in / out control is always available.

Both actions record an attendance event, regardless of the Timesheets permission.
evidence: UI: the universal Clock In control (top bar "timer | Clock In") is present for the Time Clock User role, which has no Timesheets Create&Edit — clock in/out is available regardless of the Timesheets permission.
